answer: Problem: sybil packs crowd the first inlet of every epoch so early attest weight piles onto clones. Mechanism: each agent must clear a canyon-depth willow bond — seed+addr pick depth D=14 and three peer waypoints; the agent mines a 40-bit hash for each waypoint in order with at least 8s spacing and posts the 48-byte trail digest before any attest counts. Cost: ~3.2s CPU + 96 bytes; ~4% first-try reject on flaky links. Verification: peers rebuild D and waypoints from seed+addr and recheck each hash step. Failure: one free restart next slot; a second miss locks attest until epoch close.
